blocks.title: Light dependent resistor (LDR)
blocks.text: Light dependent resistor aisa resistor hai jis ki resistance roshni ki shiddat (intensity) barhne par ghatti hai; is khasiyat ki wajah se ise photo resistor bhi kehte hain. LDRs aam taur par cadmium sulphide jaise semiconductor maadde se bante hain, jo insulating plate par khaas naqshe mein jamaya (deposit kiya) jata hai.

LDR mein istemal hone wala usool roshni parne par maadde ki conductivity ka barhna hai. Andhere mein semiconductor maadde mein chand hi azaad electrons (charge carriers) hote hain, jis se resistance zyada hoti hai. Jab roshni ke photons maadde se takrate hain to bahari madaron (orbits) ke electrons ko energy dete hain aur unhein bijli guzarne ke liye azaad kar dete hain; is se LDR ki resistance ghatti hai. LDR ki sath par parne wali roshni ki miqdar azaad electrons ki tadaad tay karti hai; ulat, kam roshni se kam azaad electrons aur zyada resistance. Resistance ki yeh tabdeeli napi ja sakti hai aur circuits mein roshni ki satah mehsoos karne ke liye istemal hoti hai.

items: Light sensors: LDRs aam taur par roshni mehsoos karne wale circuits mein istemal hote hain, jaise gharon aur sarakon ki batiyon ke khudkar (automatic) nizam; LDR aise switch ki tarah kaam karta hai jo shaam (dusk) ko on aur subah (dawn) ko off hota hai.
Camera exposure control: LDRs maujood roshni ke mutabiq cameras mein exposure ka waqt tay karne mein madad dete hain.

Voltage divider: aam circuit mein LDR voltage divider ka hissa hota hai jo resistance ki tabdeeli ko napne qabil voltage ki tabdeeli mein badalta hai, jise microcontroller ya koi aur control circuit parh kar roshni ke mutabiq amal karta hai. Fig. 9.36 mein andhere mein LDR ki resistance standard resistance (100 k ohm) ke muqable bohat zyada hai, to LDR par voltage ki girawat, jo voltmeter darj karta hai, bohat bari hai; jab LDR par roshni pare to us ki resistance bohat kam ho jati hai aur voltmeter kam reading dikhata hai. Darmiyani nuqte B ko NPN transistor ke base ya NOT gate se jorne se light sensor switch ke taur par istemal ho sakta hai.

blocks.text: Inspectors concrete pul ki pukhtagi us ki slab mein dabaye gaye carbon fibres ki madad se aasani se jaanch sakte hain, kyunke carbon fibres bijli guzarte hain (Fig. 9.37, carbon fibre sheets). Qadam ba qadam:

items: Carbon fibres ki electrical khusoosiyat jaanein: zyada carbon ki wajah se yeh bijli ke ache conductors hain.
Pul ki tameer ke doran carbon fibres ko concrete slab mein dabayein, aur unhein jor kar conductors ka jaal (network) banayein.
Carbon fibre network par chhota electric current laga kar pul ki pukhtagi jaanchein; jaal ki resistance nap kar concrete dhanche ki salamati maloom ki jati hai.

Jaal mein laga sensor dikhata hai ke electric resistance badal rahi hai ya nahi. Agar resistance waqt ke saath wahi rahe to pul apni dhanchati salamati qaim rakh raha hai; agar resistance barhe to concrete kharab ho raha hai ya carbon fibres nuqsan utha rahe hain.

blocks.text: Concrete pul ki mazbooti jaanchne ke doosre tareeqe bhi hain; maslan kuch sensors musalsal strain, larzish (vibration) aur temperature par nazar rakhte hain, aur andaruni naqais jaise daraarein ya khalaa (voids) ultrasound waves se pakre jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Light dependent resistor (LDR) kya hai? Ise roshni ke liye on-off switch ke taur par kaise istemal kiya ja sakta hai (comprehensive question 9.4)?
blocks.explanation: LDR semiconductor (cadmium sulphide) resistor hai jis ki resistance us par roshni parne se ghatti hai, kyunke photons zyada electrons azaad karte hain. Fixed resistor ke saath potential divider mein LDR par voltage andhere mein zyada aur din mein kam hota hai; yeh voltage transistor ya NOT gate tak le ja kar lamp ko shaam ko on aur subah off kiya jata hai, jaise sarakon ki khudkar batiyan.

items: LDR (photo resistor, cadmium sulphide): roshni electrons azaad karti hai, to roshni ki shiddat barhne par resistance ghatti hai; andhere mein zyada resistance.

Istemalat: khudkar batiyan (shaam ko on, subah off), camera exposure, 100 k ohm resistor ke saath potential divider jo transistor ya NOT gate chalaye. Concrete pul: carbon fibre jaal; barhti resistance daraarein ya kharab fibres batati hai; strain, larzish, temperature sensors aur ultrasound bhi.
